# dsh-loop-rescue
**English** · 简体中文
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-loop-rescue) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugi
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-loop-rescue) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
Stop repetitive DSH model output, prune the repetition from the committed message, and resume automa
tically. It catches recurring short phrases, reasoning and repeated passages of text.
Requires **DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0** and **Node.js 24.9+**. Coverage includes 0.2.1-rc.3; installati
on does not require an alpha DSH release.
## Quick start

1. Enter `dsh-loop-rescue` in **Plugins → Add plugin**, then enable it.
2. Use this or `@mrweicodes/

dsh-loop-guard`, so both do not cut the same stream.
3. The default mode rescues automatically. Use
`mode: observe` to inspect detection before allowing cuts.

## Configuration
The profile's `cordis.patch.yml` stores settings under row ID `loop-rescue`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Setting | Default | Meaning |

| `mode` | `rescue` | Prune and resume; `cut` prunes only, `observe` logs only |
| `watch` | `both`

| Watch `reasoning`, `text` or both |
| `marker` | `true` | Leave a marker at the cut |
| `maxConsec

utiveRescues` | `3` | Consecutive rescue cap; normal calls reset it |
| `stallCalls` | `3` | Nudge a

fter reasoning-only calls; 0 disables |
| `stallMinReasoningChars` | `1024` | Minimum reasoning leng

th counted as a stall |
| `retryTemperature` / `retryReasoningEffort` | Unset | Optional sampling ov

errides after rescue |
| `retryRequests` | `1` | Number of requests using those overrides |
| `langu
age` | `auto` | `auto`, `zh` or `en` |
The `detector` object adjusts thresholds; defaults usually suffice. See advanced documentation for f
ull examples, detection rules and offline tools.
## Updating
Install by npm name. Use DSH's version list when available. Otherwise, stop DSH and run:

To migrate a GitHub dependency, back up the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, remove the old package, ad
d the npm name, and verify saved settings. Maintainer publishing instructions are in PUBLISHING.md.
## Known limitations
- The committed message contains the pruned content; redrawing already streamed output depends on th

e DSH front end.
- Open tool calls prevent a cut, keeping incomplete arguments from executing.
- Rep

eated tool use across separate steps is outside the detector's scope.
- Saved history is not rewritt

en automatically. Close DSH and retain backups before offline cleaning.
- Sampling overrides require
support from the model adapter.
